title: Beyond a single latent space: a dual-latent world model for long-horizon planning
abstract: arXiv:2609.37644v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent world models often struggle with long-horizon planning despite accurate short-term predictions. Recursive rollouts accumulate errors, while distance concentration in high-dimensional latent spaces can weaken goal discrimination. We introduce the Dual-Latent World Model (Dual-WM), which separates local execution and long-range planning through distinct state representations and dynamics models. The low-level model predicts action-conditioned transitions, while the high-level model uses learned macro-actions to plan over longer temporal spans. We also propose Long-Horizon Representation Learning with Weighted Rollout (LoRe), which supervises self-generated predictions at both levels. An analysis of recursive error propagation motivates exponential horizon weights with separate decay rates for the two temporal scales. translated_title: 超越单一潜空间：面向长时程规划的双潜空间世界模型
translated_abstract: 潜空间世界模型尽管在短期预测上表现准确，但在长时程规划中常常面临困难。递归式展开会不断累积误差，而高维潜空间中的距离集中现象会削弱对目标的区分能力。我们提出了双潜空间世界模型，通过不同的状态表示和动力学模型将局部执行与长程规划分离开来。低层模型预测以动作为条件的转移，而高层模型则利用学习到的宏动作在更长的时间跨度上进行规划。我们还提出了基于加权展开的长时程表示学习方法，该方法在两个层级上对模型自生成的预测进行监督。对递归误差传播的分析表明，应采用具有独立衰减率的指数时间跨度权重来分别处理两个时间尺度。在规划过程中，高层模型生成潜空间子目标，由低层模型将其细化为具体动作。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出双潜空间世界模型（Dual-WM），通过将低层动作执行模型与高层宏动作规划模型分离，并引入具有独立衰减率的加权展开表示学习方法（LoRe）进行监督，有效解决了潜空间世界模型在长时程规划中误差累积和目标区分能力下降的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Dual-Latent World Model (Dual-WM), which separates low-level action execution from high-level macro-action planning and introduces Long-Horizon Representation Learning with Weighted Rollout (LoRe) with distinct decay rates, effectively addressing error accumulation and weakened goal discrimination in long-horizon planning with latent world models.
